snippet.title: Slash-Out: Fantasy Dueling // Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4304800/SlashOut_Fantasy_Dueling

In Slash-Out, master the sword and shield to survive in a land where every fight is a boss fight. Darkness is rising. An ancient evil has returned. Embark on a quest to restore peace, but be warned, a gauntlet of fearsome opponents stand in your way. Many have tried and failed, will you prevail?

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Caleb Draper
📚 Publisher: Caleb Draper
📅 Release Date: Sep 17, 2026
🎯 Genre: Action, Indie
